title: altensteinia riobambae
intro: Altensteinia riobambae, commonly known as Riobamba or Queñua, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Altensteinia riobambae include wound healing, gastrointestinal issues, and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
